pullA:pull-up.coach: First time: do pull-ups if you can get 6 clean reps, otherwise use the lat pulldown at a weight you can pull about 10 times.

pullA:cable-row.coach: First time: pick a weight you could row about 13 times and stop at 10.

pullA:straight-arm-pulldown.coach: First time: start light, arms straight, a weight you could do about 18 times, and stop at 15.

pullA:reverse-fly.coach: First time: use the reverse pec deck, or face pulls if it is taken, at a weight you can do 15 to 20 times cleanly.

pullA:cable-lateral.coach: Down to 5 kg: at 10 kg you got 4 to 7 reps where 12 are asked. Start each set with the left arm.

pullA:curl.coach: First time: pick dumbbells you can curl about 13 times on the incline bench and stop at 10.

legsA:leg-press.coach: First time: start well below what feels possible, a weight you could press about 13 times, and stop at 10.

legsA:rdl.coach: First time: start with a light bar, hips back and back flat, a weight you could lift about 12 times, and stop at 9.

legsA:leg-curl.coach: First time: pick a weight you could curl about 15 times and stop at 12.

legsA:leg-extension.coach: First time: very light and slow for your knee, and drop it if the spot below your left kneecap hurts.

legsA:standing-calf.coach: First time: pick a weight you could do about 15 times with a full stretch at the bottom, and stop at 12.

legsA:cable-crunch.coach: First time: pick a cable weight you could crunch about 15 times and stop at 12.

pushA:shoulder-press.coach: Stay at 15 kg and aim for 8: you got 7 on each set. Note dumbbells or machine.

pushA:incline-db-press.coach: Stay at 10 kg until every set reaches 8: you got 7 each time.

pushA:cable-lateral.coach: Down to 5 kg: at 10 kg you got 4 to 7 reps where 12 are asked. Start each set with the left arm.

pushA:chest-fly.coach: Up one step: both sets reached 15 at 25 kg.

pushA:triceps-pushdown.coach: Up one step: every set reached 15 at 20 kg.

pushA:db-lateral.coach: Down to 3 kg: at 5 kg you got 9 reps where 15 are asked.

cable-lateral.note: Too heavy for the range. Left side 1 to 2 reps behind.
